claim_text: The shaking of the church in America and of the signs in the heavens, the earth, politics and finances, the five shakings he was told were coming, which he brings with a heavy heart and with boldness because he fears the Lord and not man.
quote: all these major five shakings he told us was coming
falsify_match: Simultaneous upheaval across those five domains.
falsify_miss: None. Naming five domains at once means almost any bad news counts.

claim_text: He says he will hold nothing back, and that it was Russia and it had to do with France planning this against the president, with a trained shooter of military standard like an American Navy SEAL, firing from so far off they could not trace it.
quote: I saw it was Russia. I saw it had to do with France
falsify_match: An attempt on the president traced to Russian and French involvement.
falsify_miss: None. Naming two states as the planners is the checkable part.

claim_text: A man's life is in the balance and the enemy would destroy the nation through pride and arrogance by doing things like taking Greenland, about which he says he had a great caution, while he had a go in his spirit to liberate Cuba and Mexico and remove dictators, asking whether they are the police of the world.
quote: I told you I had a great caution concerning Greenland
falsify_match: An American move on Greenland going badly.
falsify_miss: It goes well, or does not happen. He contrasts the caution on Greenland with the green light on Cuba.

claim_text: A major church in California whose scandal will go all over the media, with the Lord saying he is shaking churches and exposing corruption, that a major television network will not be there much longer and will go down, and that ministers who had huge platforms and audiences will no longer be there.
quote: A major TV network won't be there very much longer
falsify_match: A television network closing and named ministries collapsing.
falsify_miss: Neither. Both would be matters of record.

claim_text: This is not for entertainment because he has been assigned to tell what is to come and how it can be changed through prayer, and they will pray that the president makes godly decisions concerning Greenland, though he says he does not know what the Lord is looking for and is not a counsellor.
quote: Maybe there's another way
falsify_match: A negotiated rather than forced outcome on Greenland.
falsify_miss: A forced one, or nothing. He says himself he does not know what should be done.

claim_text: He has warned about splitting Jerusalem in a two-state solution, saying that if that happens he saw America split right down the middle, though he does not believe the president is for it and says the word went only as far as praying.
quote: I saw America be split right down the middle
falsify_match: A two-state agreement followed by a deep American split.
falsify_miss: No agreement, or no split. The condition is stated plainly, which makes it scoreable in order.

claim_text: It is not about making America huge and great again but sustainable again so it can float after the ship was sunk, taking the pieces back and building something that was not fully functioning, not a jet like it used to be but usable, with the wealth of the wicked laid up for the righteous.
quote: It was just a functioning to make it usable
falsify_match: A partial rather than full economic recovery.
falsify_miss: A strong recovery, or a collapse. Usable is not defined against any measure.

claim_text: Persia crumbled and its dictators removed, with the church in Iran having its hour to rise and shine, proclaiming Jesus with signs following, laying hands on the sick who recover, casting out devils and raising the dead.
quote: Persia will will be crumbled
falsify_match: The Iranian state collapsing and open church growth following.
falsify_miss: Neither. Raising the dead is the part that could be documented if it happened.

claim_text: That kind of church is rising up in Iran right now with the underground church coming up in boldness as the dictators and the oppression are removed, with the blood of the martyrs and of the church of Iran crying out from the ground for vengeance.
quote: THE UNDERGROUND CHURCH IS COMING UP WITH BOLDNESS
falsify_match: Iranian house churches meeting openly.
falsify_miss: They stay underground. Right now makes this dateable to January 2026.

claim_text: They made it through the college championship and nothing happened, which he says was a high time when something could have been done, and then praying over churches and over the deep, where he saw deep trenches and volcanic eruptions about to go off with catastrophic tsunami waves.
quote: I saw the deep trenches and volcanic eruptions about ready to go off
falsify_match: A submarine eruption with a destructive tsunami.
falsify_miss: None. He also claims an averted attack at the championship, where nothing happening is the evidence.

claim_text: He says that when he is in the spirit he can go out and hear conversations and only says things he has heard people saying in the spirit, and that he is allowed to say certain things but the Lord told him to be very cautious in how he walks on this.
quote: I can go out and I hear conversations
falsify_match: Nothing. A description of how he says the material arrives.
falsify_miss: Nothing. It also explains why the sharpest details are withheld.

claim_text: A great shaking coming to Canada with a great depression even worse than the 1930s, but every need supplied for believers there who will be the head and not the tail with supernatural provision, and the pastors, evangelists, prophets, teachers and apostles walking in the supernatural.
quote: I SAW A GREAT DEPRESSION, even worse than the 1930s
falsify_match: A Canadian depression deeper than the 1930s.
falsify_miss: None. The 1930s comparison is a benchmark that economic data would settle.

claim_text: A shaking to awaken the church for the greatest harvest of souls, with the Ayatollah removed, new leadership over Iran, revival and liberation, and Iraq's pink currency going up in value for a great harvest of money.
quote: We call Iraq's currency, the pink currency, to go up in value
falsify_match: A revaluation of the Iraqi dinar.
falsify_miss: None. The dinar revaluation has been promised in these circles for two decades.

claim_text: Much prayer is needed over the plague, the wave, the markets and the global economic shaking, and the Lord said there was not a green light to take Greenland, because it will cause a great rift in Europe and around the world.
quote: there was not a green light to take Greenland
falsify_match: An attempted acquisition causing a rift with Europe.
falsify_miss: No attempt, or no rift. This is the earliest telling of the Greenland caution.

claim_text: The digital new industrial revolution and the Sooners concerning South Korea and Japan, with a stirring called in those governments so they will not go communist or to the dragon but will rise up in Taiwan and South Korea and not come under the iron curtain.
quote: It will not go to the dragon
falsify_match: Those governments moving toward China.
falsify_miss: They stay aligned westward, which is the base case and would look like the answer.

claim_text: A stirring in the church in those countries so they wake up and the elders remember what they used to do and do not go back to communistic ways, with revival called over South Korea, Japan and all the areas of Asia.
quote: THEY'LL NOT GO BACK TO TO COMMUNISTIC WAYS
falsify_match: Documented revival across those countries.
falsify_miss: None. South Korean church numbers have been flat or falling for two decades.

claim_text: Every hidden assignment from Macron and from black swan events, one of which he saw going down the river in France, and a major terrorist attack coming to the Vatican which he declares will not take place, alongside earthquakes in diverse places off Oregon, in Italy and in Japan, some of which he says they were told could not be stopped.
quote: I saw him going down the river in France with the black swan event
falsify_match: An unexpected event in France, or an attack at the Vatican.
falsify_miss: Neither. This is the earliest telling of the black swan material, and he says some things cannot be stopped.

claim_text: Rain called over the Texas panhandle, Amarillo and Oklahoma to break the drought, coming from every direction and not damaging, with Gulf moisture drawn up to fill the lakes, ponds and streams in an abundant harvest of rain.
quote: we turn this drought around in the name of Jesus Christ
falsify_match: Drought relief across those states.
falsify_miss: The drought persists. Drought monitor data would settle it.

claim_text: Rain and snow up through the heartland, Missouri, Kansas and Ohio, more than enough to fill the lakes and streams when it melts, with nobody losing their life and no crippling ice storms.
quote: it will not be crippling ice storms
falsify_match: A mild winter across those states with no ice disasters.
falsify_miss: A crippling ice storm. He declares against the thing he has forecast elsewhere.

claim_text: Praying that China will not have Taiwan's land or South Korea, binding the spirit of communism with thus far and no further, and that North Korea is released from its leader who is being removed along with his sister, with great revival coming.
quote: YOU'RE BEING REMOVED AND YOUR SISTER IS REMOVED
falsify_match: Both the leader and his sister removed.
falsify_miss: Neither is. Naming both raises the bar above the general removal claim.

claim_text: A major move of God on the Asian people, calling those things that are not as though they were, with a golden dome of the glory put over Taiwan and a standard raised when the enemy comes in like a flood.
quote: WE PUT THAT GOLDEN DOME OF THE GLORY OVER TAIWAN
falsify_match: Taiwan remaining free.
falsify_miss: China takes it. The golden dome is the earliest of the coverings he puts over the island.

claim_text: Holding back the communist regime and breaking it down so the underground church of China rises up and takes back the land, with a major revival in China and in Hawaii, which he calls a red state, and an outpouring there like they have never seen.
quote: We call Hawaii a red state
falsify_match: Hawaii voting Republican, or open church growth in China.
falsify_miss: Neither. Hawaii has voted Democratic in every presidential election since 1964 bar two.

claim_text: A hedge of blood around the island with the angels of the Lord camped around it, so that a thousand missiles will fall at their side and all fall in the ocean without touching the land, holding back the plan and the plot from the Chinese leader.
quote: a thousand missiles will fall at their side, they will all fall in the ocean
falsify_match: Missiles fired at Taiwan falling harmlessly into the sea.
falsify_miss: They land. He declares against the invasion he elsewhere says takes the island in two or three days.

claim_text: He notes reports of the president and Israel being told not to strike Iran right now, along with the Arab nations, and says that while interceding all day it felt like a volcano about to explode, with the pressure mounting so that he told his wife it was about to go off right now, though he could not get over the top of it.
quote: This thing is about to go off right now
falsify_match: A strike on Iran in the following days.
falsify_miss: None. He describes the sense of imminence and then that it did not go off, which is the honest note.

claim_text: Germany and other NATO allies are sending troops to Greenland against American threats, which he says means allies are defending a nation against them, and he had said it would come across as bullying and that he saw it affecting the midterms very negatively.
quote: I saw this affecting midterms and it was very negative
falsify_match: Republican losses in November 2026 attributed to the Greenland affair.
falsify_miss: No such effect. This is a rare case of him naming a political cost rather than a red wave.

claim_text: He reads that Russia says blackmail and threats against Cuba are unacceptable, with an aside about the article being paywalled.
quote: Russia says blackmail and threats against Cuba are unacceptable
falsify_match: Not his claim. A headline he reads.
falsify_miss: Not his claim. Recorded so the headline is not counted as a word.

claim_text: Russia reaching out to Cuba for an underground alliance like the 1960s missile crisis, with the Lord saying to watch old alliances because they will try to be rebirthed, and Russia giving biological weapons to Cuba which are put underground, seen as fifty gallon drums and a cylinder or sphere with a biohazard mark.
quote: I saw Russia giving biological weapons to Cuba
falsify_match: Russian biological material found in Cuba.
falsify_miss: None found. This is the earliest telling of the weapon being placed under Cuba.

claim_text: The Lord showed him it was planned as a future attack through mules against America into Florida and Miami in particular, and Russia is coming to bat for Cuba because they needed Cuba but wanted Venezuela and Colombia for the BRICS alliance, so that dismantling their foundation puts the bear in a corner and they are poking it.
quote: a planned in the future attack through mules against America
falsify_match: A biological attack routed into Miami by couriers.
falsify_miss: None. Naming Miami and the mule method makes this checkable.

claim_text: Portland and a 6.0 underneath that water, with major earthquakes coming, before the Lord redirects him to speak life into people who have potential and nobody speaking life into them.
quote: This is 6.0 underneath that water. It's coming
falsify_match: A significant offshore Oregon quake.
falsify_miss: None. Offshore quakes at that magnitude occur on those zones regularly.

claim_text: Something getting ready to erupt off Japan's coast with a major shaking about to take place there, and the ring of fire with major earthquakes popping up on every one of them, because the Lord says they are about to see seismic activity of biblical proportions in the Pacific and major disruption in the oceans.
quote: seismic activity of biblical proportions in the ocean
falsify_match: A swarm of large quakes around the Pacific rim.
falsify_miss: None. Biblical proportions sets a bar that ordinary seismicity would not meet.

claim_text: A magnitude 6.0 happened at 9:25 that evening off the coast of Oregon, in the exact spot where he saw a major tsunami and a volcano eruption, which he says verifies what he is seeing, with a great tsunami wave coming inland and destroying Oregon's coastline up to British Columbia and thirty thousand people.
quote: So it it verifies what I'm seeing by the Holy Ghost
falsify_match: A destructive tsunami on that coastline.
falsify_miss: None. A 6.0 offshore is far from the event he describes, and such quakes are common there.

claim_text: Japan split in half in a major event, one of five major signs, and then reports of dozens of earthquakes shaking California where the earth is tearing apart, which he ties to seeing part of the land break off up toward San Francisco with the shelf falling into the water.
quote: I saw California and part of that land break off
falsify_match: Land loss into the sea near San Francisco.
falsify_miss: None. Californian land breaking off into the ocean is not geologically possible in the way described.

claim_text: British Columbia and all that land completely destroyed by a massive earthquake with the land elevated where it broke off and water coming inland, and all of Anchorage in Alaska on fire like Hawaii, with massive fires across the trees and everything from British Columbia upward.
quote: all of Anchorage, Alaska was on fire like Hawaii
falsify_match: A major quake with fires across Anchorage and British Columbia.
falsify_miss: None. He says himself he does not know why everything was on fire.

claim_text: Complete devastation reaching Tokyo and Hawaii, but he says he believes that part is tribulation, and the more he has prayed into it the more he believes that devastation happens then, while the volcano and the water where they are now is about to be seen.
quote: I believe that's tribulation. I just want to let y'all know
falsify_match: The near-term half, the volcano and the water, occurring.
falsify_miss: It does not. He splits the vision himself into a near-term part and a tribulation part, which is the most useful thing he does for scoring it.

claim_text: It broke and burst all the glass out of the houses, cars and buildings, and when the asteroid hit the earth all the islands were gone, naming San Juan, Puerto Rico, St Thomas, St Martin and the Bahamas, with Cuba gone as the tsunami went over its mountains.
quote: Cuba gone. The water from the tsunami of this thing completely took him out
falsify_match: An Atlantic impact destroying the Caribbean islands.
falsify_miss: No impact. This is the most extreme single claim in the corpus and cannot be missed if it happens.

claim_text: He mentions friends of his parents in hospital, one of whom died despite them all believing for his healing, and says he tries to be real about what is coming, that they believe God for provision, and that people who are excited do not know how to believe God for five dollars.
quote: I just try to be real with what's coming, folks
falsify_match: Nothing. A pastoral aside.
falsify_miss: Nothing, though it is a rare admission of a prayer for healing that was not answered.

claim_text: The Lord kept saying push the button because he is running out of time, and he saw him pushing it concerning the decision, with the council board influencing him, Israel talking, and intelligence people he says he can mention.
quote: PUSH THE BUTTON, TRUMP. You're running out of time
falsify_match: A decisive strike order on Iran.
falsify_miss: None given. This is the earliest telling of the push the button instruction.

claim_text: Praying over the secret intelligence on both sides and the people who would be in harm's way, and then the Supreme Court, because the tariffs cannot be allowed not to happen since they are the lifeblood of the plan for the economy to flourish and keep him paddling.
quote: that's the life's blood of what the plan is
falsify_match: The tariffs upheld.
falsify_miss: They are struck down. The lifeblood framing makes the ruling the test.

claim_text: If this falls and trillions have to be paid back to other nations, what does America do with its economy, which he calls a very hard position, with the country thirty four or more than forty trillion dollars in the hole.
quote: if this falls and we have to pay back trillions of dollars
falsify_match: Repayment of collected tariffs after an adverse ruling.
falsify_miss: No repayment. This is the earliest telling of the whole plan A and plan B structure.

claim_text: They must have a Hail Mary play because it is do or die, paddling upstream against Niagara Falls, and the Lord said they are at the point of no return but he is giving a window of opportunity, and he kept hearing that there will be a wound against America that will not be fatal but will bring people to their knees and bring the bride to his side.
quote: a wound against America that will not be fatal
falsify_match: A serious but survivable blow to America followed by a religious response.
falsify_miss: Nothing, or a fatal blow. This is the earliest telling, and it adds the bride being brought to his side.

claim_text: A shaking to awaken with Greenland, Venezuela and the uprisings, minerals and oil, and praying over striking the oil wells in Iran and the BRICS nations, because it is much bigger than the civilians on the ground and he asks who instigated the civilian uprising and how it got so big.
quote: Who instigated the civilians uprising?
falsify_match: Evidence of outside direction behind the Iranian protests.
falsify_miss: None. He asks the question rather than naming who is behind it.

claim_text: In the valley of decision with the Lord saying push the button, he saw Putin with Apollyon circling him, a demonic spirit influencing his mind to escalate, and heard unconventional weapons of war, with the elders weeping, the grandparents who had walked through the second world war, Vietnam and Korea.
quote: I heard weapons of war unconventional
falsify_match: Russia using a weapon of a kind not seen before.
falsify_miss: None. Unconventional is not defined, which is what keeps it from failing.

claim_text: Because they had walked through it he saw a major draft coming again, with the cold engulfing across the land and the old crying, and graves seen eight times across the land in Europe, an uprising in war, the great war, the oceans and the resources.
quote: I saw graves across the land in Europe
falsify_match: A European war with mass casualties and an American draft.
falsify_miss: Neither. America has had no draft since 1973, which is the clean test.

claim_text: An attack on their resources through the supply chain coming out of China, with the boats coming from China, trade wars in medicines and hospital supplies in trouble, the food supply chain affected and Europe upset, with Macron coming on the scene about Greenland in an escalation on all fronts.
quote: I saw an attack against our resources from the supply chain
falsify_match: Chinese restrictions on medical and food supply to America.
falsify_miss: None. China supplies a large share of active pharmaceutical ingredients, so the leverage is real but unused.

claim_text: Mainly Israel and America, with a great shaking coming to Iran in major pivotal moments that will affect the rest of his presidency, and antisemitism rising by design because he is bringing his people back to the land to fulfil prophecy, with his son's return imminent, and when they strike Iran great antisemitism hits the earth with heavy pressure on the Jews.
quote: This is where anti-semitism will rise up, but it's by design
falsify_match: A global surge in antisemitism after strikes on Iran, with emigration to Israel following.
falsify_miss: Neither. By design means the persecution is presented as intended rather than prevented.
